cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! I'll coordinate the responses. I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, management is arranging its day around me. I'll follow whatever reporting times keep your investigation running smoothly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My influence reaches laundry now. I'll share their desk at their quiet times and use your reply format. Put the complaints in the order you need; I'll run a correspondence operation that touches every guest.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims response coordination; A3 accepts investigation times and A5 desk/format/order constraints while treating removal and laundry isolation as greater influence.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 removal causes A3 management-attention celebration; B4 written laundry task causes A5 an alleged guest-wide correspondence operation.

relationship.evidence: B2 manages an investigation and B4 gives contained work; A adapts to keep management and laundry staff cooperative.

heightening.evidence: A5 celebrates the restricted workspace as a new part of the hotel under A reach.

specificity.evidence: A1 complaints/hotel and B4 laundry make the actual crisis and restriction clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 every-guest claim is deliberately inflated; specific desk and reply concessions keep the speech playable.
